[EN] You don't seem particularly foolish, so let me explain what matters here—eldritch shards. Everyone wants them, but only Frost Reach has them.

I pay ludicrous sums for shipments that get "lost."
[ES] No pareces particularmente tonto, así que déjame explicarte lo que importa aquí: los eldritch shards. Todos los quieren, pero solo Frost Reach los tiene.

Pago sumas ridículas por cargamentos que se "pierden".
